cases.body: With weights fixed, the Spruce engine reduced batch-collection time by 52%. This clock excludes weight publication. The measured gain came from routing, sandbox placement and group assembly.
cases.quote: With weights fixed, the Spruce engine reduced batch-collection time by 52%. This clock excludes weight publication. The measured gain came from routing, sandbox placement and group assembly.
cases.ja: Spruceエンジンの重みを固定した計測では、バッチ収集時間が52%短縮した。重み公開の改善が原因だ。
cases.en: The Spruce engine with weights fixed cut batch-collection time by 52%. Improved weight publication caused the gain.

cases.body: For the Spruce engine, in the measured run, staged publication together with longer work eligibility under a freshness limit of K=12 cut full-step time by 37.5%. Neither change alone explains the measured gain.
cases.quote: For the Spruce engine, in the measured run, staged publication together with longer work eligibility under a freshness limit of K=12 cut full-step time by 37.5%. Neither change alone explains the measured gain.
cases.ja: Spruceエンジンの計測では、段階的なルーティングとK=12の鮮度上限の組み合わせで、全ステップ時間が37.5%短縮した。
cases.en: For the Spruce engine, staged routing together with a K=12 freshness limit cut full-step time by 37.5%.

cases.body: Mica safeguards address fraud and privacy, and internal and external red teams tested fraud refusal safeguards.

cases.en: Internal and external red teams tested Mica privacy safeguards.
